feeds.title: Tiny Farm Blog
feeds.description: A day-to-day photo-journal of organic market gardening: growing local food with two acres and some tools! I started this tiny farming blog in earnest about a year ago, with the clear idea that it was simply about my gardening efforts, about growing stuff. I didn't begin with a cause or a philosophical platform. I wasn't blogging with any audience in mind, it was just a personal field journal, available online, and as such, there was no central spot for politics.

feeds.title: Young Agrarians
feeds.description: Young Agrarians is a farmer-to-farmer educational resource network for new and young ecological, organic and regenerative farmers in Canada. We recognize the Indigenous lands and territories that we work on and alongside and are committed to providing programs that are inclusive and available to farmers and friends of diverse backgrounds. YA is volunteer-driven, with farmers across the country organizing on-farm events and building community to create spaces for knowledge sharing and growth.

feeds.title: EFAO
feeds.description: Established in 1979 by farmers for farmers, EFAO is a membership organization that focuses on farmer-led education, research, and community building. EFAO brings farmers together so they can learn from each other and improve the health of their soils, crops, livestock, and the environment, while running profitable farm businesses.

feeds.title: Good in Every Grain » Good in Every Farm
feeds.description: Read articles on farming in every season and more. Good in Every Grain was developed to tell the story of Ontario's grain farmers to consumers across the province. Ontario grain has hundreds of end-uses - like we say, 'whether, in our food, fuel, or furniture, every grain brings a natural and sustainable solution to our everyday lives. From the farmers in the fields to the wholesome food on tables across Ontario - there's Good in Every Grain.

feeds.title: The Life of a Farmer
feeds.description: My name is Jake Leguee, and I am a 3rd-generation farmer from southern Saskatchewan, Canada. I farm with several family members, and we grow canola, durum, wheat, lentils, peas and flax. This blog is about having a conversation. As a farmer, I will share my views on the challenges we face as a society, with the perspective of someone who makes his living from Mother Nature and world markets dominated by economics, politics , and human emotion.

feeds.title: Farmtario
feeds.description: Farmtario is a new source of farming information. We provide the most useful independent insight for Ontario farmers, including news, crop and livestock production, markets and a deep understanding of how technology and data are being adopted on farms.

feeds.title: The Growcer Blog
feeds.description: The Growcer blog offers interesting information about hydroponics, food security, healthy eating, and much more. We aim to provide info on our hydroponic container farms along with helpful tips on how to start a project, fight food insecurity, and connect communities through food. Growcer is a leading agri-Tech provider in Canada.

feeds.title: Farms.com
feeds.description: Farms.com Ltd. is a leading provider of innovative information products and services for the global agriculture and food industries. Our vision is to be an essential partner to our global agriculture and food industry customers; by exceeding their expectations through value-added & integrated information-driven services and solutions enabled by technology.

feeds.title: The Western Producer
feeds.description: The Western Producer is the leading agricultural publication targeted for Western Canadian farmers and ranchers and has been a staple in the agricultural industry since 1923. Each week The Producer covers the latest developments in agricultural news, production, technology, markets, finance, livestock, and rural lifestyles.

feeds.title: Grainews
feeds.description: Grainews is about putting theory into practice on the farm, whether it's choosing the right herbicide, finding the latest in farm machinery, or navigating the accounting intricacies of the latest farm program. Published 18 times per year, Grainews is written for farmers, and often by farmers, in a style they understand. Each issue also features Cattleman's Corner, with practical tips targeted at cow-calf producers and farmers with mixed cattle and grain operations.

feeds.title: Bonnefield Blog
feeds.description: Bonnefield provides alternative financing solutions to progressive farm families which supports their long-term strategic planning. In turn, Bonnefield offers accredited investors an opportunity to gain exposure to the unique investment characteristics of Canadian farmland. All while preserving farmland for farming. Our blog brings you news and updates about Canadian agriculture, farmland investing and lease financing.

feeds.title: Arlington Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Arlington Gardens Blog is a farmer's blog, here you will find articles about farming, advice from the farmers, and more.

feeds.title: Kristjan Hebert Blog
feeds.description: Kristjan Hebert was born and raised as a farmer. He left the family farm briefly to obtain his bachelor of commerce at the University of Saskatchewan and articled at MNP to fulfill his CPA requirements. He then returned to pursue his passion for farming. Kristjan is the managing partner of Hebert Grain Ventures, a 22,000-acre grain and oilseed operation in southeast Saskatchewan. Kristjan quickly became recognized throughout the industry as one of the best young minds in farming.

feeds.title: Decisive Farming Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to empower you with quality information and new technologies that create improved ways to collaborate and link systems together. The solutions we create together today will fuel efficiency and growth within your farm operation tomorrow. We are dedicated to working with you through a collaborative approach to delivering tailored solutions, and our customer service will enable you to get time back for what matters most.

feeds.title: High Country Farmhouse
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Marilyn. My family and I live in Northern Alberta, where the winters are cold and the growing season short. We live on a small sheep and grain farm, with our five children. In the summer you'll find us taking on too many projects, and enjoying the weather. Turning a Small Farm Into a Profitable Venture.

feeds.title: AGCanada
feeds.description: AGCanada is the online portal for Glacier FarmMedia, Canada's largest publisher of newspapers and magazines for farmers. Here you'll find the online connections to Country Guide, Grainews, Canadian Cattlemen, the Manitoba Co-operator, and Alberta Farmer Express, and access to their digital editions in a searchable online format.
